userValue: A player can see the latest equipment candidates, apply a replacement, and trust the refreshed attribute overview instead of seeing a resolver-context error or stale empty values.

Do not promote community_observed Exact instances to official Catalog facts.
Do not claim global data health is green or independently claim an authenticated save path that was not recorded in this closure turn.
